entities.summary: The Biblical Corpus encompasses 66 canonical books (Protestant) or 73 books (Catholic/Orthodox) spanning from Genesis through Revelation. Composed over roughly 1,100 years (c. 1200 BCE – 100 CE), it includes law, history, poetry, prophecy, gospels, and epistles in Hebrew, Aramaic, and Koine Greek. Foundation of Judaism and Christianity, it has shaped Western civilization, law, art, literature, and moral philosophy more than any other single collection of texts.
